description: This file declares functions related to object ID parsing and hash algorithm setup for Git-like version control system, defining interfaces to convert hex strings to object IDs, and configuring hash algorithms based on environment variables.

methods.name: cl_parse_any_oid
methods.description: Converts a hex string into an object_id structure, considering the hash algorithm based on environment variables.

methods.name: cl_setup_hash_algo
methods.description: Sets up the hash algorithm (SHA-1, SHA-256) based on environment variables, with validation.
